scope: Local read-only ChatGPT MCP facade and Secure MCP Tunnel client staging; OpenAI account-side tunnel provisioning and ChatGPT-originated calls are intentionally not claimed.

verified_behaviors: private runtime rejects anonymous direct MCP
bridge uses the local private backend credential while ignoring caller Authorization
discovery exposes exactly seven read-only tools
host_list crosses bridge into the authenticated runtime and returns all six configured hosts
shell_start is rejected by the facade before backend forwarding
MCP GET surface is not accidentally exposed

retained_failures.reason: required --token-file and --out arguments were omitted on the first invocation

retained_failures.result: one harness failure after anonymous-runtime check passed
retained_failures.reason: the acceptance client assumed application/json and did not parse text/event-stream
retained_failures.correction: test harness now requests and parses both application/json and text/event-stream; bridge/runtime assertions were not relaxed

retained_failures.evidence: profile source and profile path load were found, but control_plane.api_key file reference could not be resolved because runtime-api-key does not yet exist

account_side_remaining: Create or select an OpenAI Platform Secure MCP Tunnel associated with the target ChatGPT workspace.
Create a separate Restricted Runtime API key whose principal has Tunnels Read + Use.
Run ~/.local/bin/hepta-chatgpt-tunnel-bind interactively on qian-qi so neither secret is accepted through argv or a pipe.
Require tunnel-client doctor --profile hepta-chatgpt --explain to pass and /readyz to return 200.
In ChatGPT web developer mode, create a custom MCP server using Connection: Tunnel and Authentication: None.
Scan Tools must return exactly the seven read-only facade tools.
Run ChatGPT-originated read-only golden calls; local bridge acceptance is not a substitute.
